hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *--force*|*\ -f\ *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"push --force bloqueado por regra do projeto (M3 A2 / M5)"}}';; *) echo '{}';; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) mvn -q com.coveo:fmt-maven-plugin:format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; }; true
